3 | Grammar 9 Reported yes/ no questions

Use reported yes / no questions to tell what a speaker has asked without using the person’s exact words. When using
reported yes / no questions you often have to change pronouns and the tense of the verb.

Direct questions Reported questions
“Are you free for dinner?” He asked me if | was free for dinner.
“Are you having a good day?” He asked me if | was having a good day.
“Do you want to see a movie?” He asked me if | wanted to see a movie.
“Did you speak to your mother?” He asked me if | had spoken to my mother.
“Have you been to Michel’s?” He asked me if | had been to Michel’s.
“Will you marry me?” He asked me if | would marry him.

Rewrite the questions. Use reported questions. Then compare with a partner.
